Local storage, session storage and
cookies

localStorage persists origin data across sessions; sessionStorage is scoped to an origin and top-level tab
session. Both are synchronous string stores. Cookies can accompany matching HTTP requests and have
security attributes.
localStorage එක browser sessions අතරත් පවතිනවා. sessionStorage එක tab session එකට සීමා Jවනවා. Cookies server එකට request සමඟ යන්න පුළුවන්. HttpOnly cookie එක JS වලින් කියවන්න බැහැ.

Interview question: Where should sensitive session IDs be stored?

Answer: A server-managed Secure, HttpOnly cookie with suitable SameSite and CSRF protections is
often preferred; avoid casually storing secrets in JS-readable storage.
Remember: Local lasts, session per tab, cookie may travel.
Practice: Store an object as JSON, reload, then remove the key.
